notes:
PlaneSite 1.6.2 - colour:
- Each flight (battery) now gets its own sun-angle correction, because the sun moves between flights. In tests this cut the leftover colour differences across a multi-flight job by about five times.
- The mosaic keeps the photos' overall brightness (1.6.1 came out slightly darker).
- New Colours option under Processing options: Vivid (default) adds contrast and colour, similar to Pix4D, the same over the whole mosaic. Natural keeps the photos' own contrast and colour.
Process the project again to apply (the feature step is reused).
